svg.text: The Sixfold FPGA computer (fpga/rtl/Sixfold_System.sv) on its board
ULX3S (ECP5-85F): 33,886 LUT4s (41%), 5,546 flip-flops, 85 block RAMs, routed for 25.0 MHz and clocked at 20 MHz. Basys 3 (XC7A35T): about 17,975 LUTs (86%); Arty A7-100T: 28%.
the LEDS register (8 on ULX3S, Arty)
6 stages: F1 F2 D E M W
one digit at a time, 1 ms each
BOOT store, or a halt -> restart the core
